H02.note: Converged on a single traceAddress path returning one object or null. Besu and Erigon development builds already select by tree path, and Reth merged the path lookup in #27366 (2026-09-22). Nethermind still returns a collection and has not stated a position. This records direction from implementations, not unanimous formal approval.

sources.label: Reth #27366: select trace_get results by tree path

H03.note: Converged on direction: AND by default, retaining explicit union and intersection and rejecting unknown modes. This records direction, not unanimous formal approval or implementation uptake. Document the migration for both-lists/no-mode queries.

erigon.note: Agrees with AND by default and rejecting unknown modes, provided an explicit `mode: "intersection"` stays valid as a no-op and `mode: "union"` remains for migrating queries that supply both lists.

H07.note: Converged on carrying transactionHash in individual and block replay envelopes. Erigon and Nethermind development builds already include it, and Reth merged #27365 (2026-09-22). Besu is partial. This records direction from implementations, not unanimous formal approval.

sources.label: Reth #27365: include transaction hash in individual replays

H13.note: Converged on strict execution validation, including nonce, balance and sender-code checks. Error-code mapping and compatibility migration remain open; client implementations are not harmonized.

erigon.note: Agrees, widened to the full admission rules at the selected state: nonce, balance and EIP-3607. Asks that the error code be settled with the policy (Erigon rejects with -32000, Reth with -32000/-32003), and notes that the check interacts with any restored blockNumber field.

H18.note: Converged on reporting net EIP-7702 code changes in stateDiff. Erigon and Nethermind development builds already do, and revm-inspectors merged #509 (2026-09-15); Reth needs a release past revm-inspectors 0.43.0 to ship it. Besu is partial, and multi-authorization cases remain untested. This records direction from implementations, not unanimous formal approval.

sources.label: revm-inspectors #509: report EIP-7702 code changes in state diffs

H26.note: Converged on fork-correct deletion markers: pre-Cancun SELFDESTRUCT deletes the account, post-Cancun it deletes only accounts created in the same transaction. Besu and Erigon development builds agree; Nethermind merged #13668 (2026-09-24, in the captured development build) and revm-inspectors merged #510 (2026-09-15), which Reth ships after a release past 0.43.0. The storage of a deleted account is {} under the revised recommendation. This records direction from implementations, not unanimous formal approval.

sources.label: Nethermind #13668: serialize deleted account fields with deletion markers

H28.note: Historical trace_call agrees on every captured native build, including Erigon 3.7.0, which ships the end-of-block history boundary from #24056 (merged 2026-09-18). Two differences remain outside trace_call, both captured and both with an open fix. Besu block replay skips the block’s pre-block system calls, so the mined beacon-root and history reads see the parent’s values (Besu #10953). Erigon’s historical trace_callMany still reads the next block’s system writes at block 55 (Erigon #24293). The stricter Harmonized milestone is also blocked by schema-invalid beacon-call-55 responses from Besu and Nethermind: the beacon-roots contract REVERTs and both omit the REVERT frame result that H09 requires. This records agreement on the checked block boundary, not complete system-operation coverage or unanimous formal approval.

sources.label: Erigon #24056: read account state at the end of the requested block
Besu #10953: replay block pre-execution before tracing transactions
